senses.gloss:
दृंह् दृंह्, i. 1, and i. 4, Par., Ātm. To fasten (ved.). To be fastened (ved.).
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. दृढ,
 1. Hard, firm, Rām. 2, 56, 14; Hit. 21, 20; Hariv. 7329.
 2. Reliable, MBh. 3, 2646.
 3. Violent, MBh. 13, 1972.
 4. Great, MBh. 1, 7636. Compar. द्रढीयंस्, superl. द्रढिष्ठ. Acc. ˚ढम्, adv.
 1. Tightly, Prab. 12, 3.
 2. Much, Arj. 8, 1.
 3. Well, Mālav. 11, 8.
 4. Incessantly, MBh. 4, 314. Ved. frequent. दादृह्, To be excessively firm, Chr. 292, 10 = Rigv. i. 85, 10.
 --Cf. τραχύς.
